LanguageData.LP_ImplantTadpole.label: implant mind flayer tadpole
LanguageData.LP_ImplantTadpole.description: Place a mind flayer tadpole into the target's skull. Within about 5 days (adjustable in mod settings) the tadpole turns the host into a mind flayer, which then joins the faction of whoever performed the surgery. Doing this to an unwilling person is an atrocity.
LanguageData.LP_ImplantTadpole.jobString: Implanting a mind flayer tadpole into TargetA.
LanguageData.LP_RemoveTadpole.label: remove mind flayer tadpole
LanguageData.LP_RemoveTadpole.description: Open the skull and remove the mind flayer tadpole parasitizing the brain. It can be removed any time before ceremorphosis completes; the tadpole dies when taken out.
LanguageData.LP_RemoveTadpole.jobString: Removing a tadpole from TargetA's brain.
LanguageData.LP_RemoveTadpole.successfullyRemovedHedi: {0} successfully removed the mind flayer tadpole from {1}'s brain.
